title: Volume of first stage digester

symbols.definition: Volume of first stage digester, m³
Volume of fresh sludge m³ added per day
Detention time in the high rate digester, days

applicability: Section 6.4.5.2, sizing of a high rate digester: with good mixing and pre-thickening there is no stratification, so the first stage digester volume is fixed only by the fresh sludge volume and the high rate detention time.
